description: This file defines a foreground Android service 'NotifSshListenerService' that listens to system notifications, filters them based on user-configured app packages, constructs SSH commands from templates, executes these commands via an SSH client, and posts brief notifications about the results. It manages dependencies for preferences, secure storage, and SSH execution, and handles notification permissions and channels.

classes.name: NotifSshListenerService
classes.description: An Android NotificationListenerService that monitors system notifications, filters based on user settings, constructs and runs SSH commands, and posts notification summaries about execution results.

methods.name: onListenerConnected
methods.description: Called when the notification listener is connected; sets up the service state.

methods.name: onListenerDisconnected
methods.description: Called when the notification listener is disconnected.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine scope upon service destruction.

methods.name: onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Triggered when a new notification arrives; launches a coroutine to process it.

methods.name: handleNotification
methods.description: Processes each notification: filters, extracts data, constructs command, executes SSH, and displays result.

methods.name: runSsh
methods.description: Executes SSH command within an IO coroutine with timeout handling.

methods.name: buildCommandFromTemplate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the user-defined template with sanitized notification data.

methods.name: safeCharSeq
methods.description: Converts CharSequence to String safely, returning empty if null.

methods.name: maybeNotify
methods.description: Posts a brief local notification with the SSH execution result, respecting notification permissions.

methods.name: isPostNotificationsGranted
methods.description: Checks whether the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel if supported, for Android O+.

methods.name: summarizeResultForNotification
methods.description: Generates a brief, non-sensitive string summarizing the SSH result for notifications.
